summary: Iteration 148 verification of iteration 147 photo thumbnail fix. Backend: all 7 pytest tests in test_iteration147_photo_thumbnails.py PASS. Frontend: verified via Playwright on Photos page. Album grid renders native pointing to /api/photos/thumb/ with loading='lazy', 0 blob URLs. Album view photo grid tile is a native to /api/photos/thumb/...?w=400 with loading='lazy' (natural=400 confirming thumbnail). Clicking a tile opens the lightbox with a native src=/api/files/... (natural width 3024 = full res, no blob). Prev/next navigation works, Escape closes the lightbox. All frontend assertions from the review request are confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix pattern is correct: swapping blob-fetch + URL.createObjectURL for native with loading='lazy' is exactly what enables HTTP/2 multiplexing, browser cache, and viewport lazy-load. Verified by DOM inspection.
Width whitelist snapping (250 -> 200/320) is a good DoS guard against cache flooding — pytest confirms it accepts non-whitelisted widths without error.
ETag-based 304 revalidation works (pytest confirms) which mitigates the Cloudflare global no-store rewrite noted in the request.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 'Commitment Ceremony 2026' album containing 1 seeded photo
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 147 photo thumbnail perf fix verified end-to-end. Grid tiles use /api/photos/thumb/ (native , lazy), lightbox uses /api/files/ (full-res), no blob: URLs anywhere in the Photos flow. Backend endpoint /api/photos/thumb/{path} returns image/jpeg, honors ETag/304, snaps widths, requires auth (401 without token). All 7 pytest tests green.
rca of the issue: Original slowness caused by PhotoTile/PhotoLightbox axios GET with responseType:blob for every photo, serializing 50 XHR downloads of 2-8MB originals through the JS thread. Fix (already applied by main agent iteration 147): new /api/photos/thumb/{path}?w=400 Pillow-generated JPEG thumbnail endpoint with in-memory LRU + ETag; photo_out() now returns both `url` and `thumb_url`; PhotoTile and AlbumCard now render native with loading='lazy', PhotoLightbox uses native on full-res with adjacent prefetch. Verified: thumb is measurably smaller than original, browser lazy-loads, no blob URLs remain in DOM.
